newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan May industrial output up 7.34 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan May industrial output up 7.34 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's industrial output rose 7.34 percent in May compared to May 1996, the economics ministry said on Saturday.

The rise in May was significantly higher than an average forecast for a 4.266 percent rise compiled from a June 19 Reuters Poll of Taiwan economists. Poll forecasts ranged from a low of 2.1 percent to a high of 6.0 percent.
The strong May rise also outpaced a 6.12 percent annual rise registered in April and outstripped the year-to-date average increase of 5.94 percent clocked in the January-April period.
But the ministry issued a statement later on Saturday revising April's year-on-year growth to 7.26 percent.
The manufacturing index, including metals, machinery, information electronics, chemical and consumer products, rose 7.30 percent in May from the same month in 1996.
Real estate and construction industry output fell 5.09 percent year-on-year, but rose 6.01 percent from April.
